name: System
description: Used only by the SYSTEM account internally; not a real interactive/network logon and rarely appears in logs.

name: Interactive
description: A user logged on at the local keyboard/screen of the computer (physical console logon).

name: Network
description: A user or computer connected from the network, e.g. accessing a shared folder or printer. Most common logon type on servers.

name: Batch
description: Used by batch-queue facilities and scheduled tasks (Task Scheduler jobs run under a saved credential).

name: Service
description: A service was started by the Service Control Manager using a configured service account.

name: Proxy
description: Deprecated logon type; not used by current Windows versions.

name: Unlock
description: The workstation was unlocked using the credentials of the account that locked it.

name: NetworkCleartext
description: A network logon like type 3, but the password was passed in cleartext (e.g. IIS Basic Authentication).

name: NewCredentials
description: A caller cloned its current token and specified new credentials (e.g. RunAs /netonly). The local session keeps the original identity; the new credentials are only used for outbound network connections.

name: RemoteInteractive
description: A Terminal Services / Remote Desktop (RDP) logon to the computer.

name: CachedInteractive
description: A user logged on with cached domain credentials because a domain controller was not available (offline domain logon).

name: CachedRemoteInteractive
description: Same as RemoteInteractive, but the logon used cached credentials (rare).

name: CachedUnlock
description: The workstation was unlocked using cached credentials.
